<template>
  <view class="order-page">
    <view class="tab-bar">
      <view
        class="tab {{activeTab === item.key ? 'tab-active' : ''}}"
        wx:for="{{tabs}}"
        wx:key="key"
        data-key="{{item.key}}"
        bindtap="switchTab"
      >
        <text class="tab-text">{{item.label}}</text>
        <view wx:if="{{item.badge > 0}}" class="badge">
          <text class="badge-text">{{item.badge > 99 ? '99+' : item.badge}}</text>
        </view>
      </view>
    </view>

    <view class="order-list">
      <view
        class="order-item"
        wx:for="{{orders}}"
        wx:key="id"
        data-id="{{item.id}}"
        data-status="{{item.status}}"
        bindtap="goOrderDetail"
        bindlongpress="showActions"
      >
        <view class="order-header">
          <text class="order-no">订单号: {{item.orderNo}}</text>
          <text class="order-status" style="color: {{getStatusColor(item.status)}}">{{getStatusText(item.status)}}</text>
        </view>
        <view class="order-goods">
          <image class="goods-img" src="{{item.goodsImg}}" mode="aspectFill"></image>
          <view class="goods-info">
            <text class="goods-name">{{item.goodsName}}</text>
            <text class="goods-spec">{{item.spec}}</text>
            <view class="goods-price-row">
              <text class="goods-price">¥{{item.price}}</text>
              <text class="goods-count">x{{item.count}}</text>
            </view>
          </view>
        </view>
        <view class="order-footer">
          <text class="order-total">合计: ¥{{item.totalPrice}}</text>
          <view class="order-actions">
            <view
              wx:if="{{item.status === 'unpaid'}}"
              class="btn btn-primary"
              hover-class="btn-primary-hover"
              data-id="{{item.id}}"
              bindtap="payOrder"
            >
              <text class="btn-text">去支付</text>
            </view>
            <view
              wx:elif="{{item.status === 'shipped'}}"
              class="btn btn-default"
              data-id="{{item.id}}"
              bindtap="confirmReceive"
            >
              <text class="btn-text">确认收货</text>
            </view>
          </view>
        </view>
      </view>
    </view>

    <view wx:if="{{loading}}" class="loading">
      <text class="loading-text">加载中...</text>
    </view>
    <view wx:if="{{!loading && orders.length === 0}}" class="empty">
      <text class="empty-text">暂无订单</text>
    </view>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'

createPage({
  data: {
    activeTab: 'all',
    tabs: [
      { key: 'all', label: '全部', badge: 0 },
      { key: 'unpaid', label: '待付款', badge: 3 },
      { key: 'shipped', label: '待收货', badge: 1 },
      { key: 'completed', label: '已完成', badge: 0 }
    ],
    orders: [],
    loading: false
  },
  onLoad () {
    this.fetchOrders()
  },
  onPullDownRefresh () {
    this.fetchOrders()
  },
  onReachBottom () {
    this.loadMore()
  },
  methods: {
    getStatusColor (status) {
      const map = { unpaid: '#ff4d4f', shipped: '#1677ff', completed: '#52c41a' }
      return map[status] || '#999'
    },
    getStatusText (status) {
      const map = { unpaid: '待付款', shipped: '已发货', completed: '已完成' }
      return map[status] || '未知'
    },
    switchTab (e) {
      const key = e.target.dataset.key
      this.activeTab = key
      this.fetchOrders()
    },
    goOrderDetail (e) {
      const id = e.target.dataset.id
      wx.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/order-detail?id=' + id })
    },
    showActions (e) {
      const id = e.target.dataset.id
      const status = e.target.dataset.status
      wx.showActionSheet({
        itemList: status === 'unpaid' ? ['取消订单', '联系客服'] : ['联系客服'],
        success: (res) => {
          if (res.tapIndex === 0 && status === 'unpaid') {
            this.cancelOrder(id)
          }
        }
      })
    },
    payOrder (e) {
      const id = e.target.dataset.id
      wx.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/pay?orderId=' + id })
    },
    confirmReceive (e) {
      const id = e.target.dataset.id
      wx.showModal({
        title: '确认收货',
        content: '确认已收到商品？',
        success: (res) => {
          if (res.confirm) {
            this.doConfirmReceive(id)
          }
        }
      })
    },
    fetchOrders () {
      this.loading = true
      wx.request({
        url: '/api/orders',
        data: { status: this.activeTab },
        success: (res) => {
          this.orders = res.data.list
          this.loading = false
        }
      })
    },
    loadMore () {},
    cancelOrder (id) {},
    doConfirmReceive (id) {}
  }
})
</script>
